goal: Implement RFC 4180-style CSV field parsing with quoting, plus canonical re-encoding.

steps.description: Implement parse_record: comma splitting, quoted fields with doubled quotes, verbatim whitespace, malformed-quote errors
invariants: plain fields split on commas; empty line yields one empty field; trailing comma yields a trailing empty field
quoted fields may contain commas and doubled quotes; unterminated quotes are Err

steps.description: Implement encode_record with canonical quoting that round-trips through parse_record
invariants: fields containing commas or quotes are quoted with doubled inner quotes; plain fields stay bare
for every field list, parse_record(encode_record(fields)) == fields
